added.title: VP of Product Marketing
added.description:
Vice President, Product Marketing

Location: Los Angeles, California | Full-Time | Remote / Hybrid / On-site
Reports To: Managing Partner

About the Role

We are looking for a Vice President, Product Marketing to lead the company’s product marketing strategy, positioning, messaging, go-to-market planning, and market adoption initiatives. This is a senior leadership role responsible for connecting product strategy with customer needs, market opportunities, and commercial objectives.

The VP of Product Marketing will work closely with senior leadership, Product, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, Customer Experience, and Operations to establish clear product positioning, develop effective go-to-market strategies, and support successful product launches and ongoing product growth.

This role will have significant influence over product positioning, customer segmentation, messaging, competitive intelligence, launch strategy, sales enablement, and product adoption as the organization continues to develop.

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute the company’s overall product marketing strategy in alignment with product and business objectives.
• Establish clear positioning, messaging, value propositions, and differentiation for products and services.
• Develop go-to-market strategies and launch plans for new products, features, services, and major product enhancements.
• Partner closely with Product Management to translate product capabilities into clear customer benefits and market-facing value propositions.
• Conduct market research, customer research, competitive analysis, and industry analysis to identify product opportunities and market trends.
• Develop customer segmentation and audience strategies for different products, markets, and customer groups.
• Create product messaging frameworks, sales materials, presentations, product content, case studies, and other market-facing resources.
• Work closely with Sales and Business Development to develop sales enablement materials, competitive insights, objection-handling resources, and customer-facing messaging.
• Partner with Marketing Communications and Digital Marketing teams to develop integrated product campaigns and demand-generation programs.
• Collaborate with Customer Experience and Customer Success teams to understand customer needs, adoption barriers, feedback, and product perceptions.
• Develop product launch processes, timelines, responsibilities, communication plans, and performance measurement frameworks.
• Establish product marketing KPIs and dashboards covering product awareness, engagement, adoption, campaign performance, and commercial outcomes.
• Monitor product performance, customer behavior, market response, and competitive developments and recommend adjustments to product marketing strategies.
• Develop competitive intelligence programs and provide leadership with regular updates on market positioning and competitor activity.
• Support pricing, packaging, product positioning, and commercialization decisions through market and customer insights.
• Develop thought leadership, educational content, webinars, events, and other programs that support product awareness and market adoption.
• Ensure product messaging remains consistent across websites, sales materials, campaigns, presentations, digital channels, and customer communications.
• Work with Legal and Compliance to ensure product marketing materials and customer-facing communications meet applicable requirements.
• Manage external agencies, research partners, creative vendors, and other product marketing resources as required.
• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing product marketing team as business needs expand.
• Maintain a high standard of customer understanding, commercial judgment, strategic thinking, creativity, and execution.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a senior product marketing leader who combines strong product understanding, market insight, commercial awareness, and communication skills. You should be comfortable working between Product, Marketing, Sales, and senior leadership to translate complex products into clear and compelling market propositions.

The strongest candidates will typically have:

• 20+ years of progressive experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, product management, marketing strategy, or related leadership roles.
• Significant leadership experience as a VP of Product Marketing, senior product marketing executive, go-to-market leader, or equivalent.
• Demonstrated experience developing product positioning, messaging, launch strategies, and market adoption programs.
• Strong understanding of customer segmentation, competitive intelligence, market research, product positioning, and go-to-market planning.
• Proven ability to translate complex products, technologies, or services into clear customer value propositions.
• Strong commercial understanding and experience working with Sales and Business Development to support revenue-generating initiatives.
• Experience collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and senior leadership.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to use market research, customer insights, and performance data to guide decisions.
• Excellent writing, presentation, storytelling, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple product launches and strategic marketing initiatives simultaneously.
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, or a related field required. MBA or relevant advanced education is preferred.

Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, brokerage, trading, technology, digital assets, SaaS, or other complex product environments is a plus.

We are also interested in candidates from technology companies, financial institutions, enterprise software businesses, consumer technology companies, professional services firms, and other organizations with sophisticated product marketing functions.

Location and Work Arrangement

This position is based in Los Angeles, California. Remote, hybrid, and on-site working arrangements may be available depending on the individual, location, and business needs.

Travel may be required for product launches, customer meetings, industry conferences, strategic planning sessions, partner meetings, and other business activities.

Compensation and Benefits

The company offers a competitive executive compensation package, including:

• Competitive executive base salary
• Annual performance-based incentive
• Equity appreciation opportunities
• 401(k) retirement benefits
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Paid time off and company holidays
• Professional development and industry training
• Reimbursement for approved business travel

Final compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role.

added.title: Vice President of Product Operations
added.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung
IG Group bietet nahtloses Trading mit einer modernen Technologieplattform, die sowohl Einsteiger:innen als auch erfahrene Profis unterstützt. Das Unternehmen kombiniert benutzerfreundliche Oberflächen mit leistungsstarken Tools für Analyse, Ausführung und Risikomanagement. Kund:innen profitieren von stabilen Systemen, schnellen Transaktionen und einem hohen Sicherheitsstandard. Ein international ausgerichtetes Arbeitsumfeld mit Fokus auf Innovation und digitale Lösungen eröffnet Mitarbeitenden vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
Rollenbeschreibung
Als Vice President Product Operations verantworten Sie die operative Steuerung der globalen Produktlandschaft von IG Group und stellen reibungslose Prozesse über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus sicher. Sie koordinieren tägliche Abstimmungen zwischen Produktmanagement, Technik, Compliance, Marketing und Kundensupport, priorisieren Anforderungen und sorgen für effiziente Release- und Change-Management-Prozesse. Sie analysieren Kennzahlen zur Produktperformance, leiten Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab und stellen die Einhaltung regulatorischer Vorgaben sicher. Zudem bauen Sie ein leistungsstarkes Product-Operations-Team auf, entwickeln Standards, dokumentieren Best Practices und treiben kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voran. Diese Position ist in Vollzeit und wird vollständig remote ausgeübt.
Qualifikationen

Produkt- und Betriebsführung:
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung von Product Operations oder Produktmanagement in einem digitalen oder Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld; Fähigkeit, komplexe Produktportfolios zu strukturieren und skalierbare Prozesse aufzusetzen.
Strategie und Analyse:
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in Datenanalyse, KPI-Entwicklung und Entscheidungsfindung; Erfahrung im Aufbau von Reporting-Strukturen und in der Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen aus Produkt- und Marktanalysen.
Leadership und Zusammenarbeit:
Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung, inkl. Coaching und Weiterentwicklung von Teams; hohe Kompetenz in bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit mit Technik, Compliance, Vertrieb und Kundensupport.
Technologie- und Marktverständnis:
Fundiertes Verständnis von digitalen Plattformen, Trading- oder FinTech-Produkten, inkl. Risiko- und Sicherheitsaspekten; Routine im Arbeiten mit agilen Methoden (z.B. Scrum, Kanban).
Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management:
Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, sicher im Umgang mit internationalen Stakeholdern auf Führungsebene; verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
